email_subject: Application - Influencer Marketing Intern at Adshot
email_body:
Dear Adshot team,

I'm applying for the Influencer Marketing Internship. I've followed Adshot's work with Twitch and TikTok creators, and I'd love to help bring campaigns to success.

I'm a digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web. I manage content for client websites, build WordPress sites, and use analytics tools like Google Analytics and Search Console to track results. I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and comfortable working independently—essential in a horizontal structure.

I know Instagram and TikTok well, and I'm eager to deepen my understanding of influencer marketing. I also have basic skills in Canva and video editing, and I'm quick to learn Photoshop if needed.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht and can easily commute to Leuven. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to your team and learn from Belgium's leading influencer agency.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Adshot team,

I'm writing to apply for the Influencer Marketing Internship. As one of Belgium's leading influencer agencies, Adshot's work with top brands and early adoption of Twitch and TikTok caught my attention. I'd be excited to contribute to your campaigns and learn from your team.

My background is in digital marketing with a technical edge. I currently work as a freelance SEO and AI search specialist and as a junior digital marketer at Episto, where I handle content management, on-page SEO, and analytics for client websites. I build and optimize WordPress sites, write content that ranks, and use tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs to measure performance. This experience has taught me to take responsibility and work independently—key in a horizontal structure like yours.

I'm an active user of Instagram and TikTok, and I understand the basics of influencer marketing. While I haven't managed influencer campaigns before, I'm eager to learn and apply my content and analytical skills to help set up, manage, and evaluate campaigns. I also have experience with Canva and basic video editing, and I'm confident I can quickly pick up Photoshop if needed.

Based in Zwijndrecht, I can easily commute to your Leuven office. I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and have a working knowledge of Dutch. I'm available for a flexible schedule and remote work.

I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Adshot. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
